description: This file defines a React functional component for viewing, editing, and deleting a note based on its ID. It manages note state, handles user interactions, and interacts with context and navigation hooks.

methods.name: NoteById
methods.description: React functional component that displays, edits, and deletes a note based on the note ID from route parameters.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current title and content to the note via the updateNote method.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes the note after user confirmation and navigates back to the main app page.

calls: window.confirm("Delete this note? This action cannot be undone.")
